metaDescription: Order custom rectangular yard signs in bulk. Ideal for events, real estate, and safety messaging. Get a quick quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Rectangular yard signs offer a classic, professional shape that maximizes readability for your message. Whether you need double-sided signs for high-traffic areas or full-color printing for vibrant event promotions, the rectangular format provides a clean, stable surface that stands up to wind and weather. Choose from standard sizes like 14 1/2" x 23" or 16" x 26" to fit your specific campaign needs.
heroAltText: Custom rectangular yard signs in bulk with double-sided printing and full-color graphics for outdoor use.
